title: Viva Glint: Rewrite with Copilot for survey comments
summary: Hold: the controls table supplies the existing Glint Copilot access route for the separate Survey Taking setting, but Microsoft does not document that setting within the cited pane. The roadmap facts, off-by-default behaviour, licensing background and corrected privacy and guest-user statements are supported.

claims.claim: Rewrite with Copilot provides alternative wordings of comments survey takers have already written.
claims.quote: Rewrite with Copilot only provides rewritten versions of comments that the survey taker originally wrote.

claims.quote: When using Copilot in Viva Glint features (such as comment summarization in Copilot in Viva Glint), raw survey responses, prompts, and respondent user attributes are processed entirely within the Microsoft 365 service boundary.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure

claims.quote: Searched: Viva Glint Copilot Survey Taking enable disable individual surveys programs setting Microsoft 365 admin center. Read rewrite-comments-copilot-viva-glint and mac-copilot-access: the latter documents the existing Copilot pane, not the separate Survey Taking control.
claims.fix: Remove controls[0].ui and the corresponding rendered path; because the setting exists but its route has not been documented, remove that row rather than render its UI as 'Not yet documented'. Retain the named setting and the Microsoft guidance link in Governance controls. Replace 'using the control in the table below' in At rollout with 'Microsoft documents the setting but does not give its exact navigation path'. The feature page at https://learn.microsoft.com/viva/glint/setup/rewrite-comments-copilot-viva-glint states that the setting is independent of the existing Copilot in Viva Glint setting; do not present the existing setting's route as its location.
